question: Should ClawHub move the existing root-level skill commands under a `skill` or `skills` namespace, and which root aliases should remain during a deprecation window?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but the permanent CLI contract, alias compatibility, and deprecation timing affect existing users and scripts.

options.title: Keep root aliases, add grouped commands
options.body: Add a grouped skill namespace for discovery/install/update/list/manage commands while preserving current root commands as documented aliases for compatibility.

options.title: Hard move to grouped commands
options.body: Move commands under the skill namespace and remove most root commands, accepting a breaking CLI change for a cleaner taxonomy.

options.title: Leave current layout
options.body: Keep the current mixed root/grouped layout and rely on help grouping to distinguish skills from packages.

recommendation.title: Keep root aliases, add grouped commands
recommendation.body: Add a grouped skill namespace for discovery/install/update/list/manage commands while preserving current root commands as documented aliases for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is both the issue author and the dominant recent contributor in the current ClawHub CLI command registration history.
